title: Market Observation Record v1
description: A point-in-time market OBSERVATION produced by regime-detection (Market Intelligence). An observation is a measurement plus its historical context, and it STOPS there. It is not a prediction, not a signal, and not an instruction. Consumers may derive behaviour from `maturity` and from nothing else.

spec_version.description: Contract version this record claims. A consumer that vendors the schema asserts a sha256 match against the version it pinned.

available_at.description: The instant the value was computable given data vintage and publication lag. For revised series this is FIRST-PRINT availability, never a revision timestamp. Backtests filter on this field, never on as_of. Not derivable from as_of, which is why both are required.

supersedes.description: If this record corrects an earlier one for the same as_of, the sha256 of the superseded record. History is append-only: a correction is a NEW record with a later available_at, never a rewrite.

clock.description: Native observation frequency of the signal.

assumption_monitored.description: The abstract market assumption this signal monitors, e.g. 'bonds hedge equity drawdowns'. If the signal is a context axis rather than an assumption-monitor, this must explicitly say 'N/A because ...' rather than be omitted or left empty.

level_percentile.description: Rank of the current reading within the reference distribution named by `basis`. Meaningless without it.

basis.description: expanding = rank against the signal's own history to date (causal). trailing_fixed = rank within a fixed trailing window (causal; window is a free parameter). full_sample = rank against the whole sample, INCLUDING THE FUTURE — this leaks and is research-only.

window.description: Trailing window length in observations. Required for trailing_fixed; must be null otherwise.

calibration.description: Optional note on the empirical calibration of the percentile.

lookback_observations.description: Number of observations the change is measured over. Required whenever level_percentile_change is non-null — a delta without its horizon is uninterpretable.

assumption_state.description: For assumption-monitor signals only. DESCRIPTIVE, not behaviour-bearing: `derivation` is mandatory so the discretization is always reproducible from reading.value, which means this field adds no information beyond the continuous reading. Consumers may not branch on `status` — the continuous reading and `maturity` remain the only inputs. A context-axis signal omits this or sets it null.

status.description: Nested deliberately: only top-level `maturity` is behaviour-bearing.

derivation.description: The pre-committed rule mapping reading.value to status, including when it was committed. A threshold invented after looking at the data is not a derivation.

episodes.description: Persistence of the current condition. Descriptive: how long this environment has lasted, and how long comparable ones lasted. Never a forecast of when it ends.

cross_signal_relationships.description: Prose statements of overlap or conditioning with other signals. Prose deliberately: a numeric 'combined score' is exactly the collapse this architecture forbids.

maturity.description: THE ONLY BEHAVIOUR-BEARING FIELD. Consumers may not derive behaviour from any other field's name or value. Algo may consume research and production; anything that changes portfolio behaviour requires production.

allOf.$comment: A leaking rarity basis cannot be production. This is the structural enforcement of the causality rule — not a convention a producer is trusted to honour.
A rejected mechanism cannot be production either — mechanism is the first gate.

value.description: The primary measurement. null only when the estimator is legitimately undefined for this as_of, in which case undefined_reason must say why.

units.description: Units of `value`. Mandatory on every numeric leaf: it removes the natural shape a smuggled allocation would take, since a weight has no honest unit.

estimator.description: How the value was computed, precisely enough to reproduce it.

context_band.description: Optional verbal band for presentation only. The continuous number is the reading; a band is never the reading.

secondary_readings.description: Additional descriptors of the same signal, each carrying its own units. Preserves multi-descriptor signals without free-form keys.
